criteria.text: Detect engine identity changes (pid, or the /global/health version/boot id) and re-run the same subscription + recovery path the server performs at boot.
criteria.test_id: issue-1325-c1: engine boot identity change re-subscribes and reruns recovery

criteria.text: Make /opencode/health reflect BRIDGE liveness, not just "the engine answers HTTP". A ready engine with a dead subscription must not report ready.
criteria.test_id: issue-1325-c2: bridge liveness becomes false after the subscription is disposed

criteria.text: If the engine reports active sessions while the api_server has persisted nothing for N minutes, log loudly and attempt reattach.
criteria.test_id: issue-1325-c3: stale active engine logs an error and reattaches

criteria.text: The engine global health response exposes a per-boot identity that changes across respawns.
criteria.test_id: issue-1325-c4: client reads pid and bootId from global health

criteria.text: The live test must invoke the sandbox-owned restart-engine command after bridge degradation, preserve the api_server PID, replace engine PID and boot identity, and observe bridge health recover.
criteria.test_id: issue-1325-c5: supported engine-only restart preserves API and restores bridge
criteria.reason: S5 owns the sole sandbox; the supported replacement path is implemented and statically guarded but awaits the third serial live gate.

criteria.text: The sandbox restart-engine command refuses unowned processes, preserves the API PID, replaces and records the owned engine PID with isolated runtime environment, appends logs, and remains cleanable by down.
criteria.test_id: issue-1325-c6: engine-only sandbox restart is owned and isolated
